user.title: Watch a point for precipitation
user.description: Choose whether this watched point stays fixed or follows another entity (e.g. a device_tracker).

tracked.title: Track an entity
tracked.description: Pick any entity that exposes latitude/longitude attributes (device_tracker, person, ...).

error.entity_not_found: That entity could not be found.
error.entity_missing_coordinates: That entity has no latitude/longitude attributes right now.

abort.already_configured: This point is already being watched.

init.title: Throttling, alert thresholds and display windows

data.min_distance_meters: Minimum movement (meters) before re-fetching (tracked mode only)
data.movement_settle_seconds: Seconds movement must stop before a movement-triggered refresh fires (0 = fetch immediately, tracked mode only)
data.probability_threshold: Precipitation probability threshold (%) -- drives the alert binary_sensor
data.lookahead_hours: Alert lookahead window (hours) -- drives the alert binary_sensor
data.display_windows_hours: Display windows (comma-separated hours, e.g. 1,3,6) -- creates a probability + amount sensor per value
data.max_elevation_diff_m: Max elevation difference for sample points (m)
